data.summary: Whenever an enemy unit (other than **MONSTER** and **VEHICLE** units) in **Engagement Range** of the unit containing this model is picked to **Fall Back**, its models take **Desperate Escape tests** as if **Battle-shocked**; if it is already Battle-shocked another way, those tests get -1.
